[PORTFOLIO] Freelance Web Developer Available for New Projects

Hello, hope you all are doing great!

I'm a freelance web developer with experience working with small businesses and helping them set up their websites from scratch, from just an idea to proper deployment and ongoing management.

As a solo developer, it's often easier for business owners to stay in direct contact with me throughout the entire process. Most business owners I come across are either struggling with their current website or have had a bad experience working with a previous developer. I always try to guide my clients in the right direction by discussing multiple options and helping them choose solutions that make sense for their business while also keeping costs under control.

I build websites that are:

• Fast-loading  
• Responsive across all devices  
• Easy to scale in the future  
• Equipped with an on-demand CMS  
• Set up with basic SEO best practices  
• Built with modern technologies

I also provide support with domain registration, hosting setup, and website management. Everything is discussed and planned before implementation.

**Solutions I can help with:**

• Personal or business portfolio websites (4–5 pages)  
• E-commerce stores for selling products online  
• Contact forms that send leads directly to your email  
• Social media integration  
• Basic SEO and performance optimisation  
• Mobile-friendly layouts that work well on all screen sizes

**Pricing:** $500 – $3000+, depending on project scope.

I can share with you 3 different price quotations depending on your requirements, so that it is easy for you to select a plan that aligns with your vision and budget. Feel free to share your requirements!

Happy to connect and discuss your project.
